name: IKEA FROSTA stool, birch plywood

sources.what: product page (article 242.862.05; seat dia 13 3/4 in, W/D 16 1/2 in, seat height 17 3/4 in, tested for 220 lb) - read via search snippet; main ikea.com page now redirects (product appears discontinued in US)
assembly instructions (AA-1131405-1, 2008; 4 printed pages on 2 PDF spreads, 1 numbered step)
secondary listing (seat dia 35 cm, seat height 45 cm, 100 kg)

overallDimsMm.note: x=width, y=depth across the splayed leg feet, z=seat height; seat diameter 350. From product page (16 1/2 in = 419 mm, 17 3/4 in = 451 mm).

parts.name: seat
parts.notes: Round; 12 pre-drilled holes on the underside in 4 groups of 3 (one radial group per leg). Thickness estimated.

parts.name: leg
parts.dimsMm: ~40 wide x ~20 thick; vertical ~425, horizontal foot under seat ~130
parts.notes: Each leg is an L: the short horizontal arm lies flat under the seat along a radius and takes 3 screws; the long arm runs down at the seat rim. Sizes estimated from drawings and overall dims.

hardware.size: countersunk machine screw, hex socket, approx M6x30 (estimated)
hardware.notes: 3 per leg, driven up through the leg's horizontal arm into the seat; seat presumably has pre-fitted threaded inserts (not stated). Product page advises re-tightening after two weeks.

joins.notes: Each leg: 3 countersunk machine screws in a radial row. Legs at 90 deg spacing; the four horizontal arms point inward toward the centre.

assembly.stepsSource: official instructions AA-1131405-1: one numbered step ('1', repeated x4 legs, x3 screws each); other panels are parts list and work-surface advice
order: for each of 4 legs: place the horizontal arm on its hole group and drive 3 screws

confidence: high for part count (1 seat + 4 legs), hardware (12 countersunk hex-socket screws, key 100006) and the single step - read from the official instructions. medium for overall dims (US page via search snippet plus a secondary listing; both agree: seat dia 350, W/D 420, H 450, 100 kg). low for leg section, seat thickness and screw size (estimated).
notes: Alvar Aalto Stool 60 style; stacks. Note the US product page is no longer live; instructions are the 2008 edition.
